title: Discord followup sent as ephemeral is visible to everyone after a deferred reply
symptoms: Reply meant only for the user shows up publicly in the channel
flags: 64 on the followup has no effect
Ephemeral works without deferring and breaks once deferReply is added
cause: When a response is deferred, the deferral decides whether the final message is ephemeral. A followup that fills in the loading message ignores the ephemeral flag.
fix: Set the ephemeral flag on the deferral itself.
apply:
await interaction.deferReply({ flags: MessageFlags.Ephemeral });
await interaction.editReply("Only you can see this");
affected: Discord interactions, DEFERRED_CHANNEL_MESSAGE_WITH_SOURCE responses, as of 2026-10
